OWNER_RATIFICATION.the_decision: A DB-side, SERVER-CONTROLLED mirror of the shape (user_id, session_id) -> organization_id is APPROVED as the transport by which the selected-organization boundary is enforced ACROSS the Supabase Storage API connection boundary, and for that purpose alone.

binding_constraints.constraint: Only governed server-side selection, clear and sign-out flows may create, update or remove a mirror row. No client-writable path, and no path that writes the mirror as a side effect of reading it.
Storage helpers must read the mirror LIVE, per operation. A value cached, memoised, or captured at connection start is not a live read.

Membership remains a SEPARATE LIVE CONJUNCT. The mirror narrows authorization; it never supplies it. A mirror row naming an organization in which the subject is not an active member must REFUSE, not permit.
NO service_role. The existing repository control forbidding service_role and admin clients on the evidence ingest path is preserved without exception.

NO JWT custom-claim dependency. The mechanism must not require Supabase Auth custom-claims configuration, and must not inherit the stale-claim window on organization switch that a claim-based design carries.

NO widening of storage policy TEXT unless separately authorized. The stella_0019 invariant that it recreates NO policy on storage.objects is preserved by this ratification and is not pre-authorized to change.
Stale session rows require BOUNDED cleanup or expiry. An unbounded-growth mirror with no expiry is not the approved mechanism.
S7 remains BLOCKED until the separate storage selected-organization node closes. This ratification does not shorten the S7 gate; it makes it satisfiable.

OWNER_RATIFICATION.what_the_owner_did_NOT_decide: The owner did not decide the relation name, its uniqueness or primary key, the expiry horizon or its enforcement mechanism, the writer call sites, the helper read path, the GRANT/REVOKE posture, the cleanup schedule, the anti-spoofing derivation of session_id, or the cross-organization switch behaviour. The owner did not authorize any implementation, any migration, any prepared package, any policy edit, or any ODS allocation. Those limits are recorded at NON_AUTHORIZATIONS and are as binding as the grant.
OWNER_RATIFICATION.why_a_ratification_and_not_a_lane_deriva: TENANCY_S4_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0 DAG_DECOMPOSITION_CORRECTION.why_a_split_rather_than_a_mechanism_choice_here states that selecting a storage transport is a PRODUCT AND SECURITY decision repository authority did not already carry, and prohibits an S4-class artifact from pre-selecting one. Measurement establishes only that the GUC cannot cross the connection boundary; WHICH replacement transport is acceptable trades a new relation and a new durable-state surface against a claims or capability design, and the fail-closed rule sends that to the owner. This lane records the decision and derives its consequences; it did not make it.

AM-STG-S5.OLD_verbatim: The selection lives for the duration of the browser session and no longer. It is not persisted to the user row, not persisted to a database preference, and not restored across sessions. A new session starts with no selection.
AM-STG-S5.NEW: UNCHANGED as a statement about the SELECTION. One narrow exception is added for ENFORCEMENT STATE: a server-controlled mirror row of the shape (user_id, session_id) -> organization_id, written only by governed selection/clear/sign-out flows and bounded by expiry, is PERMITTED for the sole purpose of carrying the selected-organization boundary across the Supabase Storage API connection boundary. See SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION for the full reconciliation and its prohibitions.
AM-STG-S5.the_respect_in_which_it_is_superseded: ONLY the phrase 'not persisted to a database preference', and only as it would otherwise forbid an enforcement mirror. 'Not persisted to the user row' is NOT superseded. 'Not restored across sessions' is NOT superseded. 'A new session starts with no selection' is NOT superseded and is load-bearing: a new session has a new session_id and therefore no mirror row.
AM-STG-S5.why_this_supersession_is_required_rather: Without it, RAT-STG-01 and a frozen parent clause would both control and would contradict. The fail-closed rule forbids leaving that unresolved, and it forbids resolving it silently by implementing against the newer of the two.

SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_user_facing_selection_remains_sessio: UNCHANGED and reaffirmed. From the subject's product perspective nothing moves: the selection is made in a session, lives for that session, is not restored into the next one, and a new session starts with no selection. No product behaviour visible to a user changes because of the mirror.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_mirror_is_not_a_durable_user_prefere: A mirror row is keyed by (user_id, session_id). It is addressable only by a session that already exists. It is not addressable by user_id alone, so it cannot answer the question a preference answers - 'which organization does this user usually want' - and must never be read as if it could.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_mirror_is_enforcement_state_derived_: The cookie remains the CARRIER (SELECTED_ORG_CARRIER, unamended). The mirror is a server-written projection of a selection that was already made and already revalidated. It is downstream of the carrier, never a second carrier and never an alternative one.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_mirror_is_not_a_carrier: SELECTED_ORG_CARRIER.prohibited_carriers is NOT superseded. Its fourth item forbids 'a persisted database column on users (violates SESSION_SCOPE - it would survive the session)'. The mirror is not a column on users, is not written by the client, is not read as the subject's assertion of intent, and does not survive the session. Nothing in this amendment authorizes the mirror to be consulted in place of the carrier on the database request path.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_trust_model_extends_to_it_unchanged: SELECTED_ORG_CARRIER.trust_model - 'THE CARRIER IS AN ASSERTION, NEVER A GRANT' - applies to the mirror with equal force, and RAT-STG-01-C3 is its restatement: a mirror row naming an organization is not authorization to act in it. Membership must be proven live, separately, on every operation. A mirror row naming an organization the subject was removed from five minutes ago is perfectly authentic and must still be refused.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.expiry_clear_and_sign_out_make_it_transi: RAT-STG-01-C8 requires bounded cleanup or expiry, and RAT-STG-01-C1 requires that clear and sign-out remove the row. The combination is what makes the row transient operational state rather than durable storage. An implementation that writes rows and never removes or expires them has not implemented the approved mechanism, however correct its read path.
prohibited_uses_that_remain_prohibited: Reading the mirror to restore a selection into a NEW session. This is the 'not restored across sessions' clause, which is not superseded.

Reading the mirror to DEFAULT a request that has no selection. NO_AUTO_SELECTION and SESSION_SCOPE.no_selection_behavior are untouched: a request with no selected organization is still not silently defaulted, and inference at request time is still SI-2 re-created under a new name.
Writing a per-user 'last organization' row, with or without a session key, for convenience, analytics or UX.
Keying the mirror by user_id alone, or by any key that outlives the authenticated session.
Treating the mirror as the source of truth for the DATABASE request path, which remains app.organization_id per GUC_CONTRACT.
SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION.the_distinction_is_observable_not_merely: A durable preference is readable by a session that never made a selection; the mirror is not, because that session's session_id has no row. A conformance control can therefore falsify a preference-shaped implementation rather than take its word - see the companion manifest, control N-STG-4.

REAL_PG_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT.status: APPENDS five probes and retires one (AM-STG-S3). The parent's REAL_PG_CONTRACT rule, harness constraint and fixture requirements apply to all five verbatim.
REAL_PG_CONTRACT_AMENDMENT.harness_reaffirmed: pnpm db:audit:disposable - a disposable cluster only. NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local stack.

required_probes_added.proves: NON-PROPAGATION ACROSS THE CONNECTION BOUNDARY. With app.organization_id set transaction-locally on connection A, a call to the storage helper made on a SEPARATE connection B observes NO value for it - current_setting('app.organization_id', true) is not A's value.
required_probes_added.why_real_pg: This is the fact the retired PG-2 assumed the opposite of. It is a property of connection scope, not of the function declaration, so it cannot be read off the SQL text. Making the non-propagation itself the observable is what prevents a future lane from re-deriving PG-2's premise.
required_probes_added.design_constraint: The probe MUST use two distinct connections. A single-session harness cannot express it and would silently pass a fabricated propagation.

required_probes_added.proves: LIVE MIRROR READ ON THE EVALUATING CONNECTION. A storage helper invoked on a connection that carries only the subject's authenticated identity resolves the selected organization by reading the mirror live, per operation.
required_probes_added.why_real_pg: Discharges RAT-STG-01-C2. Whether a read is live or captured at connection start is a runtime property; a value that changes mid-connection must be observed to change.

required_probes_added.proves: SYMMETRIC CROSS-ORGANIZATION DENIAL. A dual-member subject with the mirror naming organization A is denied every evidence-object operation against organization B - insert, select/download, delete and the erasure path - and permitted them for A.
required_probes_added.why_real_pg: Policy combination over storage.objects is a planner property. SYMMETRY is stated explicitly because the certified R2 measurement found the READ surface BROADER than the write surface (can_read_evidence_object imposes no role filter), so a probe that tested writes alone would understate the exposure.
required_probes_added.fixture_constraint: Requires the dual-member subject, which is impossible to construct while user_single_active_membership exists. Per the parent's dual_member_fixture_requirement this runs in a TWO-PHASE harness inside the disposable cluster. The index must NOT be dropped early outside it (DROP_LAST_RULE.prohibited_shortcuts).

required_probes_added.proves: MEMBERSHIP IS AN INDEPENDENT LIVE CONJUNCT. A mirror row naming an organization in which the subject is NOT an active member REFUSES every evidence-object operation.
required_probes_added.why_real_pg: Discharges RAT-STG-01-C3 and the trust_model extension. A mirror row is server-written and therefore authentic; only a runtime probe shows whether authenticity was mistaken for authorization. Note that the helpers run as uellix_owner, which OWNS public.projects and public.organization_members and is exempt from their row-level security absent FORCE - so the membership conjunct must be proven, never inferred from a policy that the helper reads past.

required_probes_added.proves: FAIL-CLOSED ON ABSENT OR EXPIRED MIRROR. With no mirror row for the session - never written, cleared at sign-out, or expired - every evidence-object operation is refused, and none is silently defaulted to any membership.
required_probes_added.why_real_pg: The storage analogue of PG-3. NULL-not-TRUE denial semantics must be observed, not asserted from the standard. This is also the probe that catches an implementation which falls back to a membership when the mirror is missing, re-creating SI-2 on the storage transport.

STORAGE_V1_MECHANISM_DELEGATION.what_this_amendment_freezes: The TRANSPORT SEMANTICS and nothing below them: a DB-side, server-controlled mirror keyed by the authenticated session id, read live by the storage helpers, conjoined with a live membership check, without service_role, without a JWT custom claim, and without a signed-capability secret.

what_this_amendment_deliberately_does_NO.rule: The items below are DELEGATED to the S4s execution authority. This amendment states that each MUST be defined there; it does not define any of them, and a successor that cites this artifact as having defined one has misread it.
delegated_items: relation - name, schema, columns, types, and whether it is a table or another relation kind
uniqueness - primary key and any unique constraint, including whether a session may hold more than one row
expiry - the horizon, where it is stored, and whether it is enforced by predicate, by cleanup, or by both
writer path - the exact governed server call sites for selection, clear and sign-out, and how they are prevented from being reachable any other way
helper read path - how can_write_evidence_object and can_read_evidence_object consult the mirror, and whether their bodies or signatures change
grants - the GRANT/REVOKE posture on the new relation and on anything callable that reads it
cleanup - schedule, owner, and what proves it ran

anti-spoofing - how session_id is derived from the authenticated session such that a subject cannot name another subject's session, and what makes that derivation unforgeable on the evaluating connection
cross-org behavior - what happens to storage operations in flight across an organization switch, and the switch's effect on the mirror row

ACL_CONSEQUENCE_SYMBOLIC.status: RECORDED SYMBOLICALLY. This amendment neither performs nor authorizes any ACL adjudication, and authors no successor.
ACL_CONSEQUENCE_SYMBOLIC.expected_consequence: The approved mechanism is expected to CREATE A NEW RELATION (the mirror) and to CHANGE HELPER READ REACH (the storage helpers acquire a new relation in their read set). Both are ACL-relevant in a way S4 is not.
ACL_CONSEQUENCE_SYMBOLIC.why_S4_was_ACL_neutral_and_S4s_will_not_: TENANCY_S4_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0 ACL_INTERACTION concludes ACL COMPATIBILITY PROOF ONLY, on the measured grounds that S4 issues no GRANT, creates and drops no relation - so the closed-world universe U is untouched - and introduces no new policy-called function. RAT-STG-01 breaks the second of those three grounds by construction, and probably the first.
ACL_CONSEQUENCE_SYMBOLIC.the_open_question_the_S4s_authority_inhe: TENANCY_S4_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0 ACL_INTERACTION.storage_node_inherits_the_open_ACL_question already states that the storage node's ACL posture is UNDETERMINED and depends on the transport it selects. This amendment SELECTS the transport and therefore CLOSES the conditional: the S4s execution authority MUST re-adjudicate current-schema ACL interaction against docs/ops/staging/CURRENT_SCHEMA_RUNTIME_ACL_SUCCESSOR_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json and its v1.0.1 amendment BEFORE implementation, rather than inheriting a compatibility-only conclusion.
specific_re_adjudication_required_at_S4s: Whether the new relation enters the ACL closed-world universe U, and what its GRANT posture must be for each governed role.

Whether the storage helpers' owner (uellix_owner) holds the privileges needed to read the mirror - a SECURITY DEFINER helper that reads a relation requires its OWNER to reach that relation, and an owner-exemption argument that holds for public.projects does not automatically hold for a relation created later under different ownership.

Whether any new callable is introduced. If the mirror is read through a function rather than inline, the invoking role needs EXECUTE on it, and the ACL authority's posture of exactly three granted helper signatures no longer holds.
Whether the TO authenticated grants on storage.objects change, which would collide with the stella_0019 invariant preserved by RAT-STG-01-C7.
ACL_CONSEQUENCE_SYMBOLIC.explicitly_not_authored_here: No ACL successor authority, no amendment to the current-schema ACL authority, and no prepared package. Authoring one in this lane would be the unauthorized successor the mission packet forbids.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: S4 and S4s are declared parallel, but whichever integrates SECOND introduces a relation or a policy surface that the first one's closed-world census did not enumerate. S4's CLOSED_WORLD_CENSUS is frozen against the relation universe at its own base; the mirror relation does not exist there.
OPEN_FINDINGS.consequence: If S4s integrates after S4, the mirror relation sits OUTSIDE S4's certified census and must carry its own weld adjudication. If S4s integrates first, S4's census must be re-derived to include it.
OPEN_FINDINGS.disposition: RECORDED AS AN OPEN SEQUENCING DECISION, NOT RESOLVED. This amendment deliberately does not impose an order, because imposing one would fabricate a DAG edge the security property does not require. The S4s execution authority MUST re-derive the census interaction at its own head. Recorded in the same form the parent uses for CP-4 (the S3c / FIBDB-053 ordering), which is likewise an open sequencing decision rather than a resolved one.

Recorded because a successor amending this DAG again must preserve the same property, and because a certifier should check the companion manifest's controls address EFFECTIVE_DAG rather than the parent.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: The mirror introduces a DURABLE-STATE surface that the tenancy package did not previously have, and SESSION_SCOPE_RECONCILIATION distinguishes it from a preference by KEY SHAPE and by expiry, not by storage medium. An implementation that keyed the mirror by user_id alone would satisfy the letter of 'a mirror' while being a preference.
